title: Dexcom Announces Governance Enhancements Ahead of 2026 Investor Day
summary: Will Add Two Independent Directors with MedTech and Operations Experience to be Named at a Later Date Reconstituted Operations and Innovation Committee Will Expand Mandate to Oversee Operations, Quality and Technical Roadmap Initiatives Follow Constructive Engagement with Elliott Management DexCom, Inc.
